item.tib: mkha' 'gro dgongs pa rang grol gyi rgyud sde las byung gos lham zad med gter gtum mo ye shes me dpung
item.coloph: ces mkha' 'gro snying thig dgongs pa rang grol gyi rgyad las/ gtum mo ye shes me dpung 'di ni/ Dak+ki'i lung zin thugs sras slob ma rnams kyis nan tur bskul ba'i ngor/ snyigs dus kyi rnal 'byor kun grol grags pa 'ja' tshon snying pos/ rgyal mo rgya yi rong chen gyis (gyi) byangaphyogs/ mkha' 'gro 'du gnas ke'u tshang nyi ma rang shar gyi gnas su bstan 'gro spyi yi don la dmigs nas/ yum chen seng gdong khros ma bsgrab pa'i thun mtshams su sa rta zla ba drug pa'i tshes dkar phyogs su brtsams (rtsom) pa 'dis kyang bstan 'gro'i sman yon du gyur cig
